FINAL ANSWER: **3,815** non-reference exonic CHIP-gene variant calls remain across the 86 samples.

════════ ORDERED FILTER ATTRITION (auditable) ════════
step 0  load 86 workbooks, header=1 (row 2 = field names)      57,258 calls
step 1  restrict to the 56 Schenz CHIP symbols                  53,218   (−4,040)
step 2  drop Reference (41,116) + blank/no-call Zygosity (1,066) 11,036   (−42,182)
step 3  keep exonic SO terms only                                3,815   (−7,221)
FINAL                                                                3,815

• Step-1 dropouts are exactly the three panel-design artifacts: MMAB 3,094 / SF3B2 602 / MMACHC 344 (the 245-call impact you asked me to keep in the write-up: 4,060 → 3,815 if the Schenz filter is replaced by the files' own In_CHIP=True column).
• Step-3 dropouts (non-reference CHIP rows): intron_variant 5,983 | splice_region_variant 436 | 3′UTR 420 | 5′UTR 329 | 5′UTR_premature_start_codon_gain 50 | upstream_gene_variant 3. Note upstream_gene_variant = 3, not 59, because 56 of those 59 rows were Reference/no-calls — consistent with the "intergenic is effectively a no-op" framing you approved; no coordinate-based intergenic test was fabricated.
• Blank no-calls removed at step 2 (1,066 inside the CHIP subset; 1,151 overall): intronic 484, synonymous 254, missense 178, 5′UTR 56, splice_region 48, 3′UTR 34, inframe_ins 8, upstream 2, frameshift 2.

════════ PER-SAMPLE DISTRIBUTION (no anomalous contributor) ════════
86/86 samples contribute ≥1 call; sum 3,815; min 33 (SRR5469979), Q1 41, median 44, Q3 48, max 58 (489-PF, SRR5550381), mean 44.36, sd 5.25.
380-P = 41 (z = −0.66) and 381-PM = 38 (z = −1.23) against the other-84 comparator (mean 44.48, median 44, range 33–58, sd 5.25). Despite carrying the most raw rows in the capsule (704 and 705 vs a typical 670), both land BELOW the cohort average — their extra quasi-repeat rows are all no-call rows and were correctly excluded rather than inflating the total. Neither is an outlier (both within 1.3 sd).

════════ PER-GENE BREAKDOWN (gene-filter validity check) ════════
44 distinct Schenz symbols carry the 3,815 calls; the per-gene counts sum to exactly 3,815 and every retained row matched exactly ONE Schenz symbol (asserted True) — so no row was double-counted or matched by substring.
Top: SETBP1 328, PDGFRA 296, NOTCH1 281, CUX1 234, SF3B1 230, FLT3 184, CBLB 183, SRSF2 172, IKZF1 167, TET2 143, CSF3R 139, BCOR 116, GATA2 111, ABL1 102, SMC3 95. Bottom: CDKN2A 3, IDH1 3, CALR 3, MYD88 1, PPM1D 1. Twelve Schenz symbols have zero calls: CEBPA, FBXW7, GATA1, HRAS, NPM1, NRAS, PHF6, PTEN, PTPN11, SMC1A, STAG2, U2AF1 (HRAS/NNRAS… i.e. HRAS and NRAS never appear anywhere in the data, as found in inspection).
Comma-split behaved: 234 retained rows are multi-gene — TET2,TET2-AS1 (143), MFSD11,SRSF2 (86), GNAS,GNAS-AS1 (5) — retained on their Schenz symbol (TET2/SRSF2/GNAS); the neighbour labels were not counted as genes, and no MMAB/MMACHC/SF3B2-only row survived.
Final composition: Heterozygous 2,303 + Homozygous Variant 1,512; synonymous 2,795, missense 934, frameshift 78, inframe_ins 8; 264 unique genomic positions (secondary descriptor only); Filter=PASS for 3,815/3,815; zero duplicate (sample,Chr:Pos,allele) and zero duplicate (sample,Chr:Pos) rows inside the final set.

════════ SENSITIVITY TABLE (which row is the answer, and why) ════════
▶ PRIMARY / ANSWER — 3,815 (264 unique positions). Blanks excluded as no-calls, splice_region excluded as intronic, Schenz 56-symbol gene filter. This is the only row implementing all five of your rulings: a "non-reference variant call" needs demonstrated genotype evidence, all 2,664 splice_region rows carry intronic-side c.+N/−N offsets, and the question points at the Schenz workbook for "CHIP genes".
• S1 blanks INCLUDED as non-reference — 4,257 (+442). Largest single lever; rejected per ruling 1.
• S2 splice_region INCLUDED as exonic — 4,251 (+436). Rejected per ruling 2.
• S3 both levers open — 4,741 (+926).
• S4 gene filter = In_CHIP column instead of Schenz — 4,060 (+245). The MMAB/MMACHC/SF3B2 panel artifact.
• S5 naive keyword-exclusion rule (drop SO matching intron|UTR|intergenic|upstream, keep splice_region, keep blanks, no gene filter) — 4,997 (+1,182). Included because it is the most likely accidental implementation of this question.

════════ ZYGOSITY NORMALIZATION (your explicit request) ════════
Distinct Zygosity values across all 57,258 rows are exactly {Reference, Heterozygous, Homozygous Variant, blank}. NONE has leading/trailing whitespace (every value == its .strip()); the only case difference is ordinary sentence-case labelling. No unexpected string exists, so nothing was silently dropped or kept, and trimmed/normalized comparison changes the count by exactly 0 rows (3,815 either way). I corrected an over-eager line in my first draft of the report that flagged the three clean labels as "case-diff" — that was my comparison against lowercase, not dirty data.

════════ CROSS-VALIDATION ════════
A second, independent reader using raw openpyxl cell access with positional columns (E=Zygosity, M=Gene Names, N=Sequence Ontology) rather than pandas header=1 reproduced total = 3,815 and identical per-sample counts for all 86 samples, confirming the two-row/merged header read introduces no column shift.

════════ LIMITATIONS ════════
(1) "Intergenic" cannot be tested directly — no intergenic_variant term exists and every row is gene-attributed; discharged via upstream_gene_variant (3 non-reference calls) plus exclusion of MMAB/MMACHC/SF3B2. (2) Exonicity is judged on the single "Clinically Relevant" transcript annotation; I did not perform coordinate-based annotation (no offline reference). (3) The headline depends on the two approved judgement calls; documented alternatives span 3,815–4,997. (4) All inputs were already DP10/GQ20 PASS (Filter column PASS for 100% of rows), and per your rulings Trio_Status, the stale sheet-title variant counts, and de-duplication of multiallelic rows were all left out of the pipeline.

Artifacts: inspection/final_count.py (executed, primary), inspection/final_report.txt (its output), inspection/inspect_schema.py + inspection/inspection_report.txt (read-only schema pass).

payload.counting_unit: per-sample non-reference exonic variant calls summed across the 86 samples
